blocks.heading: Shaping the exploration game
blocks.body:
As game director, game designer, and producer, I worked with the team from the original concepts and pitch through funded development and a playable vertical slice.

My scope included game design and progression; UI/UX and prototypes; writing, world building, level and map layouts; and production, content creation, and marketing. The pitch deck and game-design documentation supported those decisions.

blocks.heading: Traversal
blocks.body: Climbing and movement in the playable slice.

blocks.heading: Character interaction
blocks.body: In-world interactions with the archipelago’s inhabitants.

blocks.heading: Tools for iteration
blocks.body: Terrain, progression, and layout tools supported the team’s work on world scale, pacing, and content. These demonstrations show the authoring workflows alongside the game they supported.

blocks.heading: Scope and outcome
blocks.body:
Lightkeeper began as Fell Out, a game-jam project. FFF Bayern concept funding in 2024 supported a larger pitch and prototype funding followed later that year.

We reached a playable vertical slice, but changes in direction also meant cutting completed survival, farming, building, and content work. The experience made scope and the core loop central production questions.
